chunks.text: Hello guys, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen. Eid Mubarak to all of you. Today I am going to make Namkeen Ghosh. If you like my recipe, please like and subscribe to my channel. We are making Mutton. We have washed the mutton. Now we will put the mutton in the cooker. We have put the mutton in the cooker. We will put little oil in the cooker. Because mutton is very soft. We will put little oil in the cooker. So that the oil will be heated. We will put little ginger in the cooker. We are making half kg mutton. So we will put little ginger in the cooker. And we will saute it. We will put green chilli in the cooker. And we will put mutton in the cooker. We will saute the mutton. We will saute it. We will put tomato in the cooker. We will put green chilli in the cooker. I have put green chilli in the cooker. We will saute it. We will put salt in the cooker. We will put black pepper in the cooker. It gives a good flavour. We will close the lid. So that the mutton will be cooked. We will mix it. We will put little garam masala. And we will put half cup water in the cooker. So that the mutton will be tender. We will put the steamer in the cooker. We will put the steamer on full flame. Rest we will put it on slow flame. We have to dry the water in the cooker. We will put the lid on. And we will dry the water. So that the water will be dried. We will serve it. Namkeen Gosht is ready. Namkeen Gosht is ready. If you like the recipe, please like it. If you like the recipe, please subscribe to my channel. I have sprinkled black pepper on top. It tastes very good.
